## Vector File Types

- [Shapefile (.shp)]{.fragment .highlight-burnt-red}
- GeoJSON (.geojson, .json)
- Keyhole Markup Language (KML, KMZ)
- Geography Markup Language (GML)
- GPS eXchange Format (GPX)
- GeoParquet (.parquet)

::: {.notes}
There are a variety of file times that vector data come in.

Your starting point is typically beholden to the vendor providing the data. For today, we'll be focusing on Shapefiles.
:::
